Gaten uses the accessibility service to take a screenshot of the screen only when you start a lookup, and to close the lookup when something interrupts it. The screenshot never leaves your device.

Gaten uses the accessibility service to capture a screenshot when you start a lookup and detect interruptions so the lookup closes automatically. The screenshot never leaves your device — Japanese text is recognised and looked up entirely offline. The service does not read notification messages or type for you.\n\nOptional, and off until you ask: WaniKani if you connect a personal access token. Connecting checks that token with wanikani.com, and each kanji you tap asks it for that character\'s page. With a token connected, Gaten also reads your own study progress from wanikani.com - the level you are on, the reviews due now and in the next 24 hours, and how your items are spread across its review stages - and keeps it on this device for the analytics screen; no lesson or review is ever answered or changed. Your selected sentence, the other words and the screenshot stay on the device.
